plotLeaflet

Source: R/plotLeaflet.R
plotLeaflet-site-method.Rd

Plot a site on a leaflet map

# S4 method for class 'site'
plotLeaflet(object)

Arguments

object

Site object to plot

Value

leaflet map

Examples

# \donttest{
modernSites <- get_sites(keyword = "Modern")
#> Warning: invalid 'scipen' 9999999, used 9999
plotLeaflet(modernSites[[1]])


# }
